name: Eau de Cumulus
prompt: Arrange dozens of perfume bottles on stepped shelves around a white cloud held in a perfumer’s wicker cradle. Pear-shaped rubber bulbs squeeze rose, jasmine and bergamot mist through long atomisers into its folds. A foot bellows lifts the scented cloud free. High above its empty cradle, its blush-coloured wake curls like the spray from the bottles below.

name: The Cats-and-Dogs Forecast
prompt: Give a cloud ferry a boarding ramp. A ginger cat, a black-and-white cat and a floppy-eared terrier walk into open pockets of soft cloud, their heads and tails still showing. The cradle tips skyward. From an airborne cloud nearby it is literally raining cats and dogs: clear feline and canine silhouettes drift down beneath little umbrella parachutes towards a quilted landing lawn.

name: The Lullaby Updraft
prompt: Build a cloud-filling music box. A keeper winds a giant pinned brass cylinder; its comb plays into a wide gramophone horn buried in a waiting cloud. An organ bellows lofts the cloud from the horn. Beneath the floating cloud, hanging bells vibrate in sequence over a shaded terrace of sleeping figures in hammocks.

name: The Firefly Night Shift
prompt: Lift the lids from amber firefly lanterns and let a stream of tiny golden lights fly through a gauze funnel into a dusk-blue cloud. A counterweighted silk sling raises it and opens. The airborne cloud now glows from within; a dotted shower of wandering fireflies lights the courtyard below. Show one empty lantern with its door still ajar.

name: The Blossom Shower
prompt: Catch loose peach-blossom petals in shallow bamboo trays beneath flowering branches. An enormous pleated hand fan sweeps the petals into a white cloud between two open trellises. The fan’s next stroke lifts it into the sky. From the departing pink-flecked cloud, five-petalled blossoms spiral down over a little tea table, one petal landing in a cup.
